label: Run the NIX-INP verifications wave 3 left unrun: eval-budget watchdog, #14339 floating ref, self.lfs/submodules across implementations and remotely, lazy fetch of unaccessed lock nodes
brief:
Run every NIX-INP verification the wave-3 dives left NOT RUN, red on the violation and green on the twin, and answer the two load-bearing questions they left open. Findings fold into nix-inputs.md as a revision that keeps every ID stable and appends a revision log.
1. nix-inputs/input-types-and-sources.md rule 9 (RUN: no), the eval-budget watchdog. Run nix flake check --no-build -v cold with per-line timestamps (ts, or awk with strftime) on helix-editor/helix@079a789e8cb0 (303 builtins.fetchTree calls), DeterminateSystems/nix-installer@76f61b5202e2 and numtide/treefmt-nix, and on two planted twins: a fetch fan-out served slowly by a local python3 -m http.server, and a hang (builtins.fetchurl to a blackholed address). Decide whether "no new checking/evaluating/downloading/copying line within 60 s" separates a live fan-out from a hang, and which budget NIX-GATE should state (M-F-18).
2. nix-inputs/follows-and-lock-hygiene.md run 3: #14339's floating-ref case was read from the issue, never re-derived. Emulate the upstream with a local bare repository whose branch advances between the dependency's lock and the consumer's removal of the follows (git+file: with ref). Show the drift, then show whether NIX-INP-08's nix flake lock --override-input restore is exact (rev and narHash).
3. nix-inputs.md NIX-INP-09: its HTTPS LFS half was not run, and 2.31.5 and Lix were not tested. Run the submodule and LFS twins under nixVersions.nix_2_31, and under Lix 2.95.2 with and without --extra-experimental-features flake-self-attrs. Run self.lfs against a real https remote (a public GitHub repository carrying LFS objects, fetched as git+https with lfs=1), or record why none was reachable.
4. nix-packaging.md open question self-submodules-remote: fetch grimoire by rev as github:grimoire-rs/grimoire (its real remote; the consolidation wrote ocx-sh/grimoire). If it is private, use a local bare clone over git+file with a rev. Run under 2.31.5, 2.35.2 and Lix with flake-self-attrs, with and without inputs.self.submodules.
5. New row M-B-17, lazy fetching. With a cold private store (--store pointing at a fresh local directory), does building a consumer's package fetch a transitive lock node nothing accesses? Cases: nix-installer's nixpkgs-regression; a planted producer with an unused test input; a flake-compat flake = false input as NIX-REL-05 prescribes. Record downloads per node. Decide NIX-INP-02 SHOULD versus MUST, and the cost of REL-05's input (map E22).
6. NIX-INP-02 claims that a same-tree path:.. from test/ to its parent is legal; this was never run (map E23). Lock and evaluate it on 2.31.5 and 2.35.2, and check whether NIX-INP-04's grep flags it.
Decide: the severity and verification changes per rule, each with the run that justifies it.
Env: Nix only via /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/run.sh (CppNix 2.35.2, nixpkgs 26.11pre 8d5d2709; 2.31.5 via nix shell nixpkgs#nixVersions.nix_2_31; Lix 2.95.2 via nix shell nixpkgs#lix; flake-checker 0.2.15, jq). Wrap each call in timeout 300. run.sh uses bwrap with WAL on, so parallel dives are fine. If timeout 60 run.sh nix --version fails, write ENVIRONMENT FAULT first and stop all Nix work. Fixtures go under /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/fixtures/verification-rerun-w3/inputs/ (never /tmp); git init -q and git add -A before any eval. Exemplars are read-only. Pipe grep and find through rtk proxy. Run every check verbatim: a directory operand, one -e per alternative, quoted --include globs, xargs -r, no placeholders. Its write-up states what empty output means, the versions, and cold or warm store.

label: Build what wave 3 left unbuilt: ocx end to end with timings and determinism, aws-lc-sys cmake mechanism, PKG-16 as a checks derivation, ocx-sdk-python import check and library export
brief:
Run the NIX-PKG builds the wave-3 dives left unbuilt, and settle the fleet packaging items by building them, not by describing them. Findings fold into nix-packaging.md as a revision that keeps every ID stable and appends a revision log.
1. ocx end to end. nix-packaging/fleet-builders.md says ocx was not built end to end, and nix-packaging.md Applied marks cargoBuildFlags and the workspace version unbuilt.
   - Copy /home/mherwig/dev/ocx into fixtures/verification-rerun-w3/packaging/ocx using git ls-files. Never use rsync --exclude. Before trusting any failure, diff the copied file list against git ls-files (PKG failure mode 12).
   - Build with nix-packaging.md's verified Rust template: version from .workspace.package.version; the ocx_cli crate selected (cargoBuildFlags or buildAndTestSubdir); both binaries, ocx and ocx-shim, installed; mainProgram = ocx; versionCheckHook; pkg-config only to start.
   - Record the first failure per -sys crate. For zstd-sys, liblzma-sys and libbz2-rs-sys, record whether the build vendors the library or links the nixpkgs one; crates/ocx_cli/tests/linux_self_contained.rs bans a libbz2 NEEDED entry.
   - Record cold and warm wall time and the closure size.
2. Determinism (M-D-24; nix-release.md open question fleet-provenance). Run nix build --rebuild on the ocx package. Does crates/ocx_cli/build.rs (vergen) embed a build timestamp that defeats SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH? If the output differs, find the minimal env that makes it reproducible.
3. NIX-GATE-10's cost. Build ocx again with the cargo vendor derivation warm and the rest of the store cold, and state the per-PR cost GATE-10 imposes on fleet CI.
4. fleet-builders.md Contested: aws-lc-sys compiled the cmake crate, but no cmake binary was supplied. Trace the mechanism from aws-lc-sys's build.rs and the -L log. Decide whether NIX-PKG-17's pkg-config-only recipe is independent of the target.
5. Map E25: nix-packaging.md Applied puts the NIX-PKG-16 floor check in checks, but its verification is a shell pipeline. Plant a checks derivation form and watch it red (channel 99.0.0) and green.
6. ocx-sdk-python. Its pythonImportsCheck line is unbuilt, and python-library-export is an open question (new row M-D-27).
   - Build it with pythonImportsCheck = [ "ocx_sdk" ].
   - Export it two ways: as packages plus an overlay through pythonPackagesExtensions, and as a top-level attribute bound to python3.
   - Have a consumer flake import it from two interpreters.
   - Decide the export shape and its check.
Decide: the verified ocx package.nix (verbatim and nixfmt-clean), the measured numbers, the Python export rule, and any severity change.

Wrap evals in timeout 300 and builds in timeout 1800. run.sh uses bwrap with WAL on, so parallel dives are fine. Fixtures go under /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/fixtures/ (never /tmp); git init -q and git add -A before any eval. Pipe grep and find through rtk proxy. brief:

   - Decide REL-13's severity and its example spelling.

   - Measure Determinate Nix 3.22.5 only if the pinned nixpkgs builds it. Otherwise record that the corpus cannot supply it (owner Q6: untested, never deliberately broken).

label: Red twins for GEN-02/04/05/16, a compliant handoff prototype rebuilt cold, the env-token and entrypoint census, and the D meta source for PKG-07
brief:
Close the NIX-GEN rows that are MUST with no watched red, make the handoff prototype compliant, and settle two open data questions. Findings fold into nix-generated-flakes.md as a revision that keeps every ID stable and appends a revision log.
1. NIX-GEN-02, 04 and 05 are MUST by reading heuristic, because no generator exists; NIX-GEN-16 has not been run. Plant twins in fixtures/verification-rerun-w3/generated-flakes/:
   - GEN-02: a flake repo with its own .py platform selector, and a data-only repo; run the GEN-02 grep on both.
   - GEN-04: a first-match (os, arch) selector, and one using ocx's relation with host libc.glibc, over the real astral-sh/ruff and amazon/corretto image indexes in /home/mherwig/dev/index. Record which manifest each picks; corretto must not be dropped.
   - GEN-05: a generator that copies kitware/cmake's linux env onto darwin, and one that reads per-platform config blobs. Compare the aarch64-darwin wrapper args.
   - GEN-16: workflow twins that git push to the default branch or open a PR; run the GEN-16 grep on both.
2. Verdict 10 lists three breaks in nix-generated-flakes/prototype/. Fix all three:
   - NIX-GEN-11: the hook must go on every *-linux package (lib/mk-package.nix:23).
   - NIX-GEN-17: pass data.json through jq -S.
   - NIX-GEN-20: use segment-escaped values, as in fixtures/nix-generated-flakes-rev/env-escape/.
   Then run: nix build --rebuild of every layer FOD (cold); the smoke check for actionlint, ninja, cmake and corretto; aarch64-darwin drvPath eval; gen13-check.sh; the GEN-19 jq; the GEN-07 overlay jq; Q5; nixfmt; deadnix. Copy the compliant result over prototype/, drop the stray result symlink, and record every exit code.
3. M-E-11 remainder. Census the latest config blobs of all packages (reuse cached blobs under fixtures/verification-rerun-w2/, else fetch with the Bearer QQ== header). Count every interpolation-token form in env values: installPath, self.installPath, self.env.KEY, deps.NAME.installPath, the :posix and :native modifiers, and the doubled-dollar escape. Count entrypoints too (command aliases and baked args). Decide per form whether to translate, inline or refuse (GEN-20 throws today), and whether entrypoints map to makeWrapper --add-flags. Plant one entrypoint twin.
4. New row M-E-31; map E15. NIX-PKG-07 makes description, license and platforms MUST, while NIX-GEN-14 omits a missing license. Measure how many of the 1,720 image indexes carry org.opencontainers.image.description, url and source annotations, and decide the D meta rule: source each field, or omit it.
5. Map E26. Verdict 3 cites nix run of kitware.cmake at version 4.4.2, but cmake has five binaries and no mainProgram (NIX-GEN-13). Record what that command actually does, and replace the example with a single-binary package.
Decide: the rule-text and severity changes per ID, and the prototype's compliance table.
